verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's agentic workflows marketing says the AI agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and automatically escalate high-risk or complex cases to human experts. Humans can review or override any agent decision, and cases must be assigned to an agent. However, nothing shows that customers can set their own policy controlling what gets auto-remediated: the Starter plan configuration "cannot be customized," and the evidence is thin marketing copy rather than technical docs. missing for 10: documented user-configurable policy controls (thresholds/rules) governing automatic remediation, technical documentation of escalation criteria for ambiguous findings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
